offering_description.value: EverQuote helps consumers shop for auto, homeowners and renters insurance online. It matches shoppers with insurance carriers and agents, who pay for referrals.

primary_services.value: insurance quote matching; shopper referrals for carriers and agents

customer_segment.value: B2B: Insurance carriers, agencies and independent agents that pay for referrals; B2C: Drivers, homeowners and renters who use the free quote-matching service

end_markets.value: personal auto insurance; homeowners insurance; renters insurance

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Shopper referrals delivered as quote requests, clicks or phone calls

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Uses shopper information and insurer criteria to match consumers and deliver referrals to carriers and agents

specialization.value: related lines: Auto, homeowners and renters insurance quote matching

distribution_channels.value: online: Company-operated insurance shopping websites; direct sales: Direct relationships with insurance carriers and agencies; partners / resellers: Third-party publishers that refer insurance shoppers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Handling shopper data and generating leads under state privacy laws and federal telemarketing rules
